HARVARD COLLEGE
Request for Dean’s Letter

Mather House
Office of the Allston Burr Senior Tutor
Harvard College, Cambridge, MA 02138
617-495-4829 (phone); 617-496-2355 (fax)
STUDENT:      Please complete this form and give it to your Allston Burr Senior Tutor.
Preparation and Release of Dean’s Letter

I hereby request that Harvard College prepare a Dean’s Letter in support of my application(s) to professional school or for a fellowship. I understand and agree that, to prepare the Dean’s Letter, officers of the College, including my Allston Burr Senior Tutor and others, will access my educational records.
I further request that Harvard College send the Dean’s Letter to the institutions that I designate. I will provide my Allston Burr Senior Tutor with a written list of all such institutions.
Waiver of Access to Dean’s Letter
I understand that, under the Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act, 20 U.S.C. § 1232g (“FERPA”), I have the right to see the Dean’s Letter.
I hereby ____ WAIVE / ____ DO NOT WAIVE my right of access under FERPA with respect to the Dean’s Letter.
